source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: जेड-ट्र्याक विधि मांसपेशीमा सुई दिँदा मुख्य रूपमा केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: जेड-ट्र्याक विधिमा सुई दिनुअघि छाला र तन्तु सारिन्छ ताकि औषधि छालामुनि फर्केर चुहिँदैन, जसले जलन र दाग घटाउँछ।

question: Which of the following is a correct principle of documentation in nursing?
options: Record only at the end of the week
Record accurately, promptly and objectively, using only approved abbreviations
Record what others told you as your own observation
explanation: Nursing documentation must be accurate, prompt, objective and complete, using only approved abbreviations, and never altered after the event.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: नर्सिङमा दस्तावेजीकरणको सही सिद्धान्त कुन हो?
options_ne: सही, छिटो र वस्तुनिष्ठ रूपमा लेख्नु, स्वीकृत संक्षिप्त रूप मात्र प्रयोग गर्नु
अरूले भनेको कुरा आफ्नो अवलोकन भनेर लेख्नु
explanation_ne: नर्सिङ दस्तावेज सही, छिटो, वस्तुनिष्ठ र पूरा हुनुपर्छ, स्वीकृत संक्षिप्त रूप मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुपर्छ र घटनापछि बदल्नु हुँदैन।

question: Informed consent means the patient has been given what before agreeing to treatment?
options: Full information about the procedure, risks, benefits and alternatives
explanation: Informed consent requires that the patient understands the procedure, its risks and benefits, and the alternatives, before agreeing voluntarily.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: सूचित सहमति भनेको उपचारमा सहमत हुनुअघि बिरामीलाई के दिइएको हुन्छ?
options_ne: प्रक्रिया, जोखिम, लाभ र विकल्पबारे पूरा जानकारी
explanation_ne: सूचित सहमतिका लागि बिरामीले स्वेच्छाले सहमत हुनुअघि प्रक्रिया, यसको जोखिम र लाभ र विकल्प बुझेको हुनुपर्छ।

question: Which of the following best describes therapeutic communication?
options: Listening actively, showing empathy and encouraging the patient to express feelings
explanation: Therapeutic communication uses active listening, empathy and open questions to help the patient express feelings and participate in care.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: चिकित्सकीय सञ्चार (थेराप्युटिक कम्युनिकेसन) को सबैभन्दा राम्रो वर्णन कुन हो?
options_ne: सक्रिय रूपमा सुन्नु, सहानुभूति देखाउनु र बिरामीलाई भावना व्यक्त गर्न प्रोत्साहित गर्नु
explanation_ne: चिकित्सकीय सञ्चारमा सक्रिय सुन्नु, सहानुभूति र खुला प्रश्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ, जसले बिरामीलाई भावना व्यक्त गर्न र हेरचाहमा सहभागी हुन मद्दत गर्छ।

question: Maslow's hierarchy of needs places which need at the base (most basic)?
explanation: In Maslow's hierarchy, physiological needs such as air, water, food and sleep are the most basic and must be met first.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: मास्लोको आवश्यकता पदानुक्रममा सबैभन्दा आधारभूत (तल्लो) आवश्यकता कुन हो?
explanation_ne: मास्लोको पदानुक्रममा हावा, पानी, खाना र निद्रा जस्ता शारीरिक आवश्यकता सबैभन्दा आधारभूत हुन् र पहिले पूरा गर्नुपर्छ।

question: Which of the following is a sign that a wound is infected?
options: Increasing pain, redness, swelling and pus
explanation: An infected wound shows increasing pain, redness, swelling, warmth and purulent discharge.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: घाउ संक्रमित भएको संकेत कुन हो?
options_ne: बढ्दो दुखाइ, रातोपन, सुजन र पिप
explanation_ne: संक्रमित घाउमा बढ्दो दुखाइ, रातोपन, सुजन, तातोपन र पिपयुक्त स्राव देखिन्छ।

question: Aseptic technique during wound dressing aims to prevent what?
options: Contamination of the wound with microorganisms
explanation: Aseptic technique prevents microorganisms from entering the wound during dressing, reducing the risk of wound infection.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: घाउ ड्रेसिङमा एसेप्टिक प्रविधिको उद्देश्य के रोक्नु हो?
explanation_ne: एसेप्टिक प्रविधिले ड्रेसिङ गर्दा घाउमा सूक्ष्मजीव पस्नबाट रोक्छ र घाउको संक्रमणको जोखिम घटाउँछ।

question: Which of the following is the correct method to check the placement of a nasogastric tube?
options: Aspirate gastric contents and check pH, and confirm with X-ray if in doubt
Ask the patient if it feels right
Check the length of tube outside only
explanation: Nasogastric tube placement is checked by aspirating contents and testing pH (acidic gastric fluid), with X-ray confirmation when in doubt; the 'whoosh' test alone is not reliable.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: नाकबाट पेटमा राखिने ट्युब (नासोग्यास्ट्रिक ट्युब) को स्थान जाँच्ने सही तरिका कुन हो?
options_ne: पेटको तरल पदार्थ तानेर pH जाँच्नु र शंका भएमा एक्स-रे गर्नु
बिरामीलाई ठिक लाग्यो कि भनेर सोध्नु
explanation_ne: नासोग्यास्ट्रिक ट्युबको स्थान पेटको तरल पदार्थ तानेर pH (एसिडिक) जाँचेर पुष्टि गरिन्छ, शंका भएमा एक्स-रे गरिन्छ; 'हुस' परीक्षण मात्र भरपर्दो हुँदैन।

question: Which of the following is the most reliable way to identify a patient before giving medicine?
options: Checking two identifiers such as name and date of birth or hospital number
explanation: Two patient identifiers, such as name and date of birth or hospital number, must be checked before giving any medicine.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: औषधि दिनुअघि बिरामी पहिचान गर्ने सबैभन्दा भरपर्दो तरिका कुन हो?
options_ne: नाम र जन्म मिति वा अस्पताल नम्बर जस्ता दुई पहिचान जाँच्नु
explanation_ne: कुनै पनि औषधि दिनुअघि नाम र जन्म मिति वा अस्पताल नम्बर जस्ता दुई पहिचान जाँच्नुपर्छ।

question: Which ethical principle means doing good and acting in the patient's best interest?
explanation: Beneficence is the ethical principle of doing good and acting in the patient's best interest; non-maleficence means doing no harm.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: कुन नैतिक सिद्धान्तको अर्थ राम्रो गर्नु र बिरामीको हितमा काम गर्नु हो?
explanation_ne: बेनेफिसेन्स राम्रो गर्नु र बिरामीको हितमा काम गर्ने नैतिक सिद्धान्त हो; नन-मालेफिसेन्सको अर्थ हानि नगर्नु हो।

question: Which of the following is the best action when a patient refuses a prescribed medicine?
options: Respect the refusal, explore the reason, inform the doctor and document it
explanation: A competent patient may refuse treatment; the nurse should respect the refusal, explore the reason, inform the doctor and document the refusal.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: बिरामीले लेखिएको औषधि खान अस्वीकार गरेमा सबैभन्दा राम्रो कार्य के हो?
options_ne: अस्वीकारलाई सम्मान गर्नु, कारण बुझ्नु, डाक्टरलाई जानकारी दिनु र दस्तावेज गर्नु
explanation_ne: सक्षम बिरामीले उपचार अस्वीकार गर्न सक्छन्; नर्सले अस्वीकारलाई सम्मान गर्नुपर्छ, कारण बुझ्नुपर्छ, डाक्टरलाई जानकारी दिनुपर्छ र दस्तावेज गर्नुपर्छ।

question: Oxygen saturation (SpO2) is measured with which device?
explanation: A pulse oximeter measures oxygen saturation (SpO2) non-invasively, usually on a fingertip.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Nursing Fundamentals
question_ne: अक्सिजन स्याचुरेसन (SpO2) कुन उपकरणले नापिन्छ?
explanation_ne: पल्स अक्सिमिटरले अक्सिजन स्याचुरेसन (SpO2) बिना चिरफार नाप्छ, सामान्यतया औँलाको टुप्पोमा।

question: Hypertension is defined as blood pressure at or above which level?
explanation: Hypertension is generally defined as blood pressure of 140/90 mmHg or above on repeated measurements.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भनेको रक्तचाप कति वा बढी हुनु हो?
explanation_ne: उच्च रक्तचाप सामान्यतया बारम्बार नाप्दा १४०/९० mmHg वा बढी हुनु हो।

question: Which of the following is a common sign of a stroke?
options: Sudden weakness on one side of the body, facial droop and slurred speech
explanation: Stroke typically presents suddenly with one-sided weakness, facial droop, slurred speech or sudden vision loss; it is an emergency.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: स्ट्रोकको सामान्य लक्षण कुन हो?
options_ne: शरीरको एकतर्फ अचानक कमजोरी, अनुहार झोलिनु र बोली लरबरिनु
explanation_ne: स्ट्रोक प्रायः अचानक एकतर्फ कमजोरी, अनुहार झोलिनु, बोली लरबरिनु वा दृष्टि अचानक गुम्नुले देखिन्छ; यो आपतकाल हो।

question: The FAST acronym for stroke recognition stands for what?
explanation: FAST stands for Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty and Time to call emergency services.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: स्ट्रोक चिन्ने FAST संक्षिप्त रूपको अर्थ के हो?
explanation_ne: FAST भनेको अनुहार झोलिनु, हात कमजोर हुनु, बोली गाह्रो हुनु र आपतकालीन सेवा बोलाउने समय हो।

question: A patient with diabetes mellitus should be advised to check blood sugar regularly and to do what?
options: Take medicines regularly, follow diet advice and inspect the feet daily
explanation: Diabetic patients should take medicines regularly, follow diet advice, exercise, and inspect their feet daily to prevent ulcers.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: मधुमेह भएको बिरामीलाई रगतमा चिनी नियमित जाँच्नु र के गर्न सल्लाह दिनुपर्छ?
options_ne: औषधि नियमित खानु, आहार सल्लाह पालना गर्नु र दैनिक खुट्टा जाँच्नु
explanation_ne: मधुमेहका बिरामीले औषधि नियमित खानुपर्छ, आहार सल्लाह पालना गर्नुपर्छ, व्यायाम गर्नुपर्छ र घाउ रोक्न दैनिक खुट्टा जाँच्नुपर्छ।

question: Hypoglycaemia in a diabetic patient is best treated immediately with what?
options: A fast-acting sugar such as glucose tablets or juice
explanation: Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar) is treated at once with fast-acting sugar, such as glucose tablets or juice, followed by a longer-acting carbohydrate.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: मधुमेहको बिरामीमा हाइपोग्लाइसेमिया (रगतमा चिनी कम) को तत्काल उपचार के हो?
options_ne: छिटो काम गर्ने चिनी जस्तै ग्लुकोज चक्की वा रस
explanation_ne: हाइपोग्लाइसेमियाको तत्काल उपचार छिटो काम गर्ने चिनी, जस्तै ग्लुकोज चक्की वा रस, हो, त्यसपछि लामो समय काम गर्ने कार्बोहाइड्रेट दिइन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a sign of heart failure?
explanation: Heart failure typically causes breathlessness (especially lying flat), ankle oedema, fatigue and weight gain from fluid retention.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: मुटुको कमजोरी (हार्ट फेलियर) को लक्षण कुन हो?
options_ne: तौल घट्नु र भोक कम हुनु
सास फेर्न गाह्रो, खुट्टा सुन्निनु र थकाइ
explanation_ne: हार्ट फेलियरमा प्रायः सास फेर्न गाह्रो (विशेष गरी सुत्दा), खुट्टा सुन्निनु, थकाइ र तरल पदार्थ जमेर तौल बढ्नु हुन्छ।

question: Myocardial infarction (heart attack) pain is typically described as what?
options: Sharp pain that worsens on breathing
Central crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm or jaw
Burning pain in the upper abdomen only
Pain that disappears with rest in seconds
explanation: A heart attack typically causes central crushing or heavy chest pain, often radiating to the left arm, jaw or back, lasting more than 15-20 minutes.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: मुटुको हृदयघात (मायोकार्डियल इन्फार्क्सन) को दुखाइ सामान्यतया कस्तो हुन्छ?
options_ne: बायाँ हात वा बङ्गारातिर फैलिने छातीको बीचमा थिचिने दुखाइ
explanation_ne: हृदयघातमा प्रायः छातीको बीचमा थिचिने वा भारी दुखाइ हुन्छ, प्रायः बायाँ हात, बङ्गारा वा ढाडतिर फैलिन्छ र १५–२० मिनेटभन्दा बढी रहन्छ।

question: Asthma is characterised by which of the following?
options: Recurrent wheezing, breathlessness and chest tightness
explanation: Asthma is a chronic airway disease with recurrent wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness and cough, often worse at night or early morning.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: दम (अस्थमा) को विशेषता के हो?
options_ne: बारम्बार सिटी बज्ने सास, सास फेर्न गाह्रो र छाती कसिनु
explanation_ne: अस्थमा दीर्घकालीन श्वासनली रोग हो जसमा बारम्बार सिटी बज्ने सास, सास फेर्न गाह्रो, छाती कसिनु र खोकी हुन्छ, प्रायः राति वा बिहान बढ्छ।

question: A patient having an acute asthma attack should be given which drug first?
options: A short-acting bronchodilator such as salbutamol by inhaler
explanation: A short-acting bronchodilator such as salbutamol by inhaler is the first-line reliever in an acute asthma attack.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: दमको तीव्र आक्रमण भएका बिरामीलाई पहिले कुन औषधि दिनुपर्छ?
options_ne: साल्बुटामोल जस्तो छोटो समय काम गर्ने ब्रोन्कोडाइलेटर इनहेलरबाट
explanation_ne: साल्बुटामोल जस्तो छोटो समय काम गर्ने ब्रोन्कोडाइलेटर इनहेलरबाट दिनु दमको तीव्र आक्रमणमा पहिलो रोजाइको उपचार हो।

question: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is most commonly caused by what?
explanation: Cigarette smoking is the commonest cause of COPD; indoor air pollution from biomass fuel is also important in Nepal.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: दीर्घकालीन अवरोधक फोक्सो रोग (COPD) को सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण के हो?
explanation_ne: चुरोट पिउनु COPD को सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण हो; नेपालमा दाउराबाट हुने भित्री वायु प्रदूषण पनि महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।

question: Tuberculosis most commonly affects which organ?
explanation: Tuberculosis most commonly affects the lungs (pulmonary TB), though it can affect almost any organ.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: क्षयरोगले सबैभन्दा बढी कुन अंगलाई असर गर्छ?
explanation_ne: क्षयरोगले सबैभन्दा बढी फोक्सो (पल्मोनरी टीबी) लाई असर गर्छ, यद्यपि यसले लगभग कुनै पनि अंगलाई असर गर्न सक्छ।

question: The DOTS strategy for tuberculosis treatment means what?
options: Giving all drugs at home without supervision
Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course, where a health worker watches the patient take each dose
explanation: DOTS means Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course: a trained observer watches the patient swallow each dose, ensuring adherence and cure.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: क्षयरोग उपचारको DOTS रणनीति भनेको के हो?
options_ne: बिना निगरानी घरमा सबै औषधि दिनु
प्रत्यक्ष अवलोकन उपचार, छोटो कोर्स, जहाँ स्वास्थ्य कार्यकर्ताले बिरामीले हरेक मात्रा खाएको हेर्छन्
explanation_ne: DOTS भनेको प्रत्यक्ष अवलोकन उपचार, छोटो कोर्स हो: प्रशिक्षित पर्यवेक्षकले बिरामीले हरेक मात्रा निलेको हेर्छन्, जसले औषधि सेवन र निको सुनिश्चित गर्छ।

question: Which of the following is a common side effect of anti-tuberculosis drugs?
options: Liver damage (hepatotoxicity) and orange urine from rifampicin
explanation: Anti-tuberculosis drugs can damage the liver, and rifampicin turns urine, sweat and tears orange-red; patients must be warned.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: क्षयरोगविरुद्धका औषधिको सामान्य साइड इफेक्ट कुन हो?
options_ne: कलेजोमा क्षति र रिफाम्पिसिनले पिसाब सुन्तला हुनु
explanation_ne: क्षयरोगविरुद्धका औषधिले कलेजोमा क्षति पुर्‍याउन सक्छन् र रिफाम्पिसिनले पिसाब, पसिना र आँसु सुन्तला-रातो बनाउँछ; बिरामीलाई जानकारी दिनुपर्छ।

question: A patient who has lost a lot of fluid from vomiting should be given what first?
options: Oral rehydration fluids or intravenous fluids as advised
explanation: Fluid loss from vomiting is replaced first with oral rehydration fluids, or intravenous fluids if the patient cannot drink or is severely dehydrated.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: बान्ताबाट धेरै तरल पदार्थ गुमाएको बिरामीलाई पहिले के दिनुपर्छ?
options_ne: सल्लाहअनुसार मुखबाट पुनर्जलीकरण तरल पदार्थ वा शिराबाट तरल पदार्थ
explanation_ne: बान्ताबाट तरल पदार्थ गुम्दा पहिले मुखबाट पुनर्जलीकरण तरल पदार्थ दिइन्छ, वा बिरामीले पिउन नसकेमा वा गम्भीर निर्जलीकरण भएमा शिराबाट तरल पदार्थ दिइन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a common complication of a long-standing peptic ulcer?
options: Bleeding, perforation or gastric outlet obstruction
explanation: A long-standing peptic ulcer can bleed, perforate the stomach wall, or scar and block the outlet of the stomach.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: लामो समयदेखिको पेटको अल्सरको सामान्य जटिलता कुन हो?
options_ne: रगत बग्नु, प्वाल पर्नु वा पेटको निकास बन्द हुनु
explanation_ne: लामो समयदेखिको पेटको अल्सरबाट रगत बग्न सक्छ, पेटको भित्तामा प्वाल पर्न सक्छ वा दागले पेटको निकास बन्द हुन सक्छ।

question: A patient with appendicitis typically has pain that does what?
options: Starts around the navel and moves to the right lower abdomen
explanation: Appendicitis pain typically starts around the navel and then moves to the right lower abdomen (McBurney's point), with tenderness and fever.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: एपेन्डिसाइटिस भएको बिरामीको दुखाइ सामान्यतया कस्तो हुन्छ?
options_ne: नाभिवरीपरी सुरु भएर दायाँ तल्लो पेटतिर सर्छ
explanation_ne: एपेन्डिसाइटिसको दुखाइ प्रायः नाभिवरीपरी सुरु भएर दायाँ तल्लो पेट (म्याकबर्नी बिन्दु) तिर सर्छ, दुखाइ र ज्वरोसँगै।

question: Which of the following is the first action when a patient is found unresponsive and not breathing normally?
options: Call for help and start chest compressions (CPR)
Move the patient to a chair
explanation: For an unresponsive patient not breathing normally, call for help and start CPR with chest compressions immediately.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: बिरामी बेहोस र सामान्य रूपमा सास नफेरेको पाइएमा पहिलो कार्य के हो?
options_ne: मद्दत बोलाउनु र छाती थिचेर CPR सुरु गर्नु
explanation_ne: बेहोस र सामान्य रूपमा सास नफेरेको बिरामीमा मद्दत बोलाउनु र तुरुन्तै छाती थिचेर CPR सुरु गर्नुपर्छ।

question: The correct rate of chest compressions in adult CPR is about how many per minute?
explanation: Adult CPR chest compressions should be at 100-120 per minute, at a depth of 5-6 cm, with minimal interruptions.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: वयस्क CPR मा छाती थिच्ने सही दर प्रति मिनेट करिब कति हो?
explanation_ne: वयस्क CPR मा छाती थिच्ने दर प्रति मिनेट १००–१२० हुनुपर्छ, गहिराइ ५–६ सेमि, कम अवरोधसहित।

question: A patient with a head injury who becomes drowsy and vomits repeatedly should be suspected of having what?
explanation: Drowsiness with repeated vomiting after a head injury suggests rising intracranial pressure and needs urgent assessment.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: टाउकोमा चोट लागेको बिरामी सुस्त भएर बारम्बार बान्ता गरेमा के शंका गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: टाउकोमा चोट लागेपछि सुस्त हुनु र बारम्बार बान्ता गर्नुले खोपडीभित्रको दबाब बढेको संकेत गर्छ र तत्काल मूल्याङ्कन चाहिन्छ।

question: The Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) assesses which three responses?
options: Eye opening, verbal response and motor response
explanation: The GCS assesses eye opening, verbal response and motor response, with a total score from 3 (deep coma) to 15 (fully awake).
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: ग्लास्गो कोमा स्केल (GCS) ले कुन तिन प्रतिक्रिया मूल्याङ्कन गर्छ?
options_ne: आँखा खोल्नु, मौखिक प्रतिक्रिया र मोटर प्रतिक्रिया
explanation_ne: GCS ले आँखा खोल्नु, मौखिक प्रतिक्रिया र मोटर प्रतिक्रिया मूल्याङ्कन गर्छ, कुल अंक ३ (गहिरो कोमा) देखि १५ (पूरी रूपमा सचेत) सम्म।

question: Which of the following is the best nursing care for a patient with a fracture in a plaster cast?
options: Elevate the limb, check circulation and watch for swelling or numbness
explanation: A casted limb should be elevated, and circulation, sensation and movement checked regularly for swelling, numbness or compartment syndrome.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: प्लास्टर भएको बिरामीको सबैभन्दा राम्रो नर्सिङ हेरचाह कुन हो?
options_ne: अंग माथि उठाउनु, रक्तसञ्चार जाँच्नु र सुजन वा लाटोपन हेर्नु
explanation_ne: प्लास्टर भएको अंग माथि उठाउनुपर्छ र रक्तसञ्चार, संवेदना र हलचल नियमित जाँच्नुपर्छ, सुजन, लाटोपन वा कम्पार्टमेन्ट सिन्ड्रोम हेर्न।

question: Which of the following is a common cause of urinary tract infection?
options: Bacteria entering the urinary tract, most often Escherichia coli
explanation: Most urinary tract infections are caused by Escherichia coli from the bowel entering the urethra and bladder.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: पिसाब नलीको संक्रमणको सामान्य कारण कुन हो?
options_ne: पिसाब नलीमा ब्याक्टेरिया पस्नु, प्रायः इश्चेरिचिया कोलाई
explanation_ne: धेरैजसो पिसाब नलीको संक्रमण आन्द्राबाट आएको इश्चेरिचिया कोलाई मूत्रमार्ग र मूत्राशयमा पस्दा हुन्छ।

question: A patient with chronic kidney disease should be advised to do what?
options: Limit salt, potassium and protein as advised and take medicines regularly
Drink as much water as possible
explanation: Chronic kidney disease care includes limiting salt, potassium and protein as advised, controlling blood pressure and taking medicines regularly.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: दीर्घकालीन मिर्गौला रोग भएको बिरामीलाई के सल्लाह दिनुपर्छ?
options_ne: पोटासियम धेरै भएको खाना स्वतन्त्र रूपमा खानु
सल्लाहअनुसार नुन, पोटासियम र प्रोटिन सीमित गर्नु र औषधि नियमित खानु
explanation_ne: दीर्घकालीन मिर्गौला रोगको हेरचाहमा सल्लाहअनुसार नुन, पोटासियम र प्रोटिन सीमित गर्नु, रक्तचाप नियन्त्रण गर्नु र औषधि नियमित खानु पर्छ।

question: Which of the following is a complication of immobility in a hospitalised patient?
explanation: Immobility causes venous stasis and increases the risk of deep vein thrombosis, as well as pressure ulcers, pneumonia and muscle wasting.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: अस्पतालमा भर्ना भएको बिरामीमा निष्क्रियताको जटिलता कुन हो?
explanation_ne: निष्क्रियताले शिरामा रगत जम्न थाल्छ र गहिरो शिरा थ्रोम्बोसिसको जोखिम बढाउँछ, साथै प्रेसर अल्सर, निमोनिया र मांसपेशी क्षय पनि हुन्छ।

question: The best way to prevent deep vein thrombosis in a bedridden patient is what?
options: Early mobilisation, leg exercises and compression stockings as advised
explanation: Early mobilisation, ankle and leg exercises and graduated compression stockings help prevent DVT in bedridden patients.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Medical-Surgical Nursing
question_ne: ओछ्यानमा परेको बिरामीमा गहिरो शिरा थ्रोम्बोसिस रोक्ने सबैभन्दा राम्रो तरिका के हो?
options_ne: छिटो हलचल, खुट्टाको व्यायाम र सल्लाहअनुसार कम्प्रेसन मोजा
explanation_ne: छिटो हलचल, गोलीगाँठो र खुट्टाको व्यायाम र कम्प्रेसन मोजाले ओछ्यानमा परेको बिरामीमा DVT रोक्न मद्दत गर्छ।

question: The main aim of community health nursing is to do what?
options: Promote health and prevent disease in the community
explanation: Community health nursing aims to promote health, prevent disease and provide care to people in their own community.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य नर्सिङको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: समुदायमा स्वास्थ्य प्रवर्द्धन र रोग रोकथाम गर्नु
explanation_ne: सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य नर्सिङको उद्देश्य समुदायमा स्वास्थ्य प्रवर्द्धन गर्नु, रोग रोक्नु र मानिसलाई आफ्नै समुदायमा हेरचाह दिनु हो।

question: A home visit by a community health nurse should begin with what?
options: Introducing oneself, explaining the purpose and gaining the family's trust
explanation: A home visit begins with a proper introduction, explaining the purpose of the visit and building trust with the family.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य नर्सको घर भेट कुन कुराबाट सुरु गर्नुपर्छ?
options_ne: आफ्नो परिचय दिनु, उद्देश्य बताउनु र परिवारको विश्वास जित्नु
explanation_ne: घर भेट उचित परिचय, भेटको उद्देश्य बताउने र परिवारसँग विश्वास बनाउने बाट सुरु हुन्छ।

question: Which of the following is the best way to prevent the spread of diarrhoeal disease in a community?
options: Safe water, sanitation and handwashing with soap
explanation: Safe water, proper sanitation and handwashing with soap are the most effective community measures against diarrhoeal disease.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: समुदायमा झाडा रोग फैलिनबाट रोक्ने सबैभन्दा राम्रो तरिका कुन हो?
options_ne: सुरक्षित पानी, सरसफाइ र साबुनले हात धुनु
explanation_ne: सुरक्षित पानी, उचित सरसफाइ र साबुनले हात धुनु समुदायमा झाडा रोगविरुद्ध सबैभन्दा प्रभावकारी उपाय हो।

question: The cold chain in immunisation means what?
options: Keeping vaccines at 2-8°C from manufacture to use
explanation: The cold chain is the system of keeping vaccines at 2-8°C from manufacture through transport and storage until use, so they stay effective.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: खोपमा कोल्ड चेन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: कोल्ड चेन भनेको खोप निर्माणदेखि ढुवानी र भण्डारण हुँदै प्रयोगसम्म २–८°से मा राख्ने प्रणाली हो, ताकि खोप प्रभावकारी रहोस्।

question: Which vaccine-preventable disease causes a barking cough and difficulty breathing in children?
explanation: Diphtheria causes a thick grey membrane in the throat, a barking cough and breathing difficulty, and is prevented by the DPT vaccine.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: कुन खोपले रोक्न सकिने रोगले बच्चामा भुक्ने खोकी र सास फेर्न गाह्रो गर्छ?
explanation_ne: डिप्थेरियाले घाँटीमा बाक्लो खैरो झिल्ली, भुक्ने खोकी र सास फेर्न गाह्रो गर्छ र डीपीटी खोपले रोक्छ।

question: Which of the following is a responsibility of a health post in-charge in Nepal?
options: Supervise staff, manage drug supplies and send monthly reports
explanation: A health post in-charge supervises the staff, manages drugs and supplies, and sends monthly reports to the district health office.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: नेपालमा स्वास्थ्य चौकी प्रमुखको जिम्मेवारी कुन हो?
options_ne: कर्मचारी सुपरिवेक्षण गर्नु, औषधि आपूर्ति व्यवस्थापन गर्नु र मासिक प्रतिवेदन पठाउनु
explanation_ne: स्वास्थ्य चौकी प्रमुखले कर्मचारी सुपरिवेक्षण गर्छन्, औषधि र आपूर्ति व्यवस्थापन गर्छन् र जिल्ला स्वास्थ्य कार्यालयमा मासिक प्रतिवेदन पठाउँछन्।

question: The Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) approach is used to do what?
options: Assess and manage sick children under five using a standard protocol
explanation: IMNCI is a standard protocol to assess, classify and manage sick children under five, covering cough, diarrhoea, fever, malnutrition and ear problems.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: नवजात तथा बाल रोगको एकीकृत व्यवस्थापन (IMNCI) दृष्टिकोण केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: मानक प्रोटोकल प्रयोग गरेर पाँच वर्षमुनिका बिरामी बच्चाको मूल्याङ्कन र व्यवस्थापन गर्नु
explanation_ne: IMNCI पाँच वर्षमुनिका बिरामी बच्चाको मूल्याङ्कन, वर्गीकरण र व्यवस्थापन गर्ने मानक प्रोटोकल हो, जसले खोकी, झाडा, ज्वरो, कुपोषण र कानको समस्या समेट्छ।

question: The incidence of a disease means what?
options: The total number of cases at one time
The number of new cases occurring in a population over a period of time
The number of deaths from the disease
The number of people at risk only
explanation: Incidence is the number of new cases of a disease occurring in a population during a specified period; prevalence is the total number of cases at one time.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: रोगको इन्सिडेन्स भनेको के हो?
options_ne: निर्दिष्ट अवधिमा जनसंख्यामा हुने नयाँ केस संख्या
explanation_ne: इन्सिडेन्स भनेको निर्दिष्ट अवधिमा जनसंख्यामा हुने रोगका नयाँ केसको संख्या हो; प्रिभ्यालेन्स भनेको एक समयमा कुल केस संख्या हो।

question: Which of the following is the best indicator of the health status of a community?
explanation: The infant mortality rate is a sensitive indicator of a community's health, reflecting nutrition, sanitation, maternal care and health services.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: समुदायको स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाको सबैभन्दा राम्रो सूचक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: शिशु मृत्यु दर समुदायको स्वास्थ्यको संवेदनशील सूचक हो, जसले पोषण, सरसफाइ, मातृ हेरचाह र स्वास्थ्य सेवा झल्काउँछ।

question: Safe motherhood programmes aim mainly to reduce what?
explanation: Safe motherhood programmes aim to reduce maternal and neonatal deaths through antenatal care, skilled birth attendance and emergency obstetric care.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: सुरक्षित मातृत्व कार्यक्रमको मुख्य उद्देश्य के घटाउनु हो?
explanation_ne: सुरक्षित मातृत्व कार्यक्रमले गर्भावस्था जाँच, दक्ष प्रसूति सहयोग र आपतकालीन प्रसूति हेरचाहबाट मातृ र नवजात मृत्यु घटाउने लक्ष्य राख्छ।

question: Which of the following is a method of health education?
explanation: Health education uses lectures, group discussions, demonstrations, posters and folk media to change knowledge, attitudes and practices.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: स्वास्थ्य शिक्षाको विधि कुन हो?
explanation_ne: स्वास्थ्य शिक्षामा व्याख्यान, समूह छलफल, प्रदर्शन, पोस्टर र लोक माध्यम प्रयोग गरिन्छ, जसले ज्ञान, धारणा र अभ्यास बदल्छ।

question: The epidemiological triad consists of agent, host and what third element?
explanation: The epidemiological triad explains disease as the interaction of the agent, the host and the environment.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: एपिडेमियोलोजिकल ट्रायडमा एजेन्ट, होस्ट र तेस्रो तत्व के हो?
explanation_ne: एपिडेमियोलोजिकल ट्रायडले रोगलाई एजेन्ट, होस्ट र वातावरणको अन्तरक्रियाबाट व्याख्या गर्छ।

question: Which of the following is the most important step in preventing food poisoning?
options: Washing hands, cooking food thoroughly and storing it properly
explanation: Food poisoning is prevented by handwashing, cooking food thoroughly, storing it at safe temperatures and avoiding cross-contamination.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: खाद्य विषाक्तता रोक्ने सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण कदम कुन हो?
options_ne: हात धुनु, खाना राम्रोसँग पकाउनु र उचित रूपमा भण्डारण गर्नु
explanation_ne: खाद्य विषाक्तता हात धुनु, खाना राम्रोसँग पकाउनु, सुरक्षित तापक्रममा भण्डारण गर्नु र क्रस-दूषणबाट बच्नुले रोकिन्छ।

question: A community health nurse conducting a survey should first do what?
options: Define the objectives and plan the survey method
explanation: A survey begins with clear objectives and a plan for the population, sample, method and tools, before any data are collected.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Community Health Nursing
question_ne: समुदाय स्वास्थ्य नर्सले सर्वेक्षण गर्दा पहिले के गर्नुपर्छ?
options_ne: उद्देश्य परिभाषित गर्नु र सर्वेक्षण विधिको योजना बनाउनु
explanation_ne: सर्वेक्षण स्पष्ट उद्देश्य र जनसंख्या, नमुना, विधि र उपकरणको योजनाबाट सुरु हुन्छ, तथ्यांक संकलन गर्नुअघि।

question: The normal duration of human pregnancy is about how many weeks?

question: Which of the following is a local level government in Nepal?
explanation: Rural municipalities (gaunpalika) and municipalities are local level governments in Nepal.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — General Awareness and Public Management
question_ne: नेपालमा स्थानीय तहको सरकार कुन हो?
explanation_ne: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिका नेपालमा स्थानीय तहका सरकार हुन्।

question: Aspirin belongs to which group of drugs?
explanation: Aspirin is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, reduce fever and inflammation.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: एस्पिरिन कुन समूहको औषधि हो?
explanation_ne: एस्पिरिन नन-स्टेरोइडल एन्टी-इन्फ्लेमेटरी औषधि (NSAID) हो जुन दुखाइ कम गर्न, ज्वरो घटाउन र सुजन कम गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: Which of the following is the specific antidote for paracetamol poisoning?
explanation: N-acetylcysteine is the antidote for paracetamol poisoning; it protects the liver when given early.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: पारासिटामोल विषाक्तताको विशिष्ट एन्टीडोट कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एन-एसिटिलसिस्टिन पारासिटामोल विषाक्तताको एन्टीडोट हो; छिटो दिँदा यसले कलेजो जोगाउँछ।

question: Amoxicillin belongs to which group of antibiotics?
explanation: Amoxicillin is a penicillin antibiotic, effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: एमोक्सिसिलिन कुन समूहको एन्टिबायोटिक हो?
explanation_ne: एमोक्सिसिलिन पेनिसिलिन एन्टिबायोटिक हो, जुन धेरै प्रकारका ब्याक्टेरिया संक्रमणमा प्रभावकारी छ।

question: Which of the following is a common side effect of antibiotics?
explanation: Antibiotics can disturb the normal gut bacteria and commonly cause diarrhoea.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: एन्टिबायोटिकको सामान्य साइड इफेक्ट कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एन्टिबायोटिकले आन्द्राको सामान्य ब्याक्टेरिया बिगार्न सक्छ र प्रायः झाडा लाग्छ।

question: Naloxone is the antidote for poisoning with which drug?
explanation: Naloxone is a pure opioid antagonist that reverses respiratory depression from opioid overdose.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: नालोक्सोन कुन औषधिको विषाक्तताको एन्टीडोट हो?
explanation_ne: नालोक्सोन शुद्ध ओपिओइड एन्टागोनिस्ट हो जसले ओपिओइड अधिक मात्राले हुने श्वासप्रश्वासको अवरोध उल्टाउँछ।

question: Which of the following is a side effect of insulin therapy?
explanation: The commonest side effect of insulin therapy is hypoglycaemia, when blood sugar falls too low.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: इन्सुलिन उपचारको साइड इफेक्ट कुन हो?
explanation_ne: इन्सुलिन उपचारको सबैभन्दा सामान्य साइड इफेक्ट हाइपोग्लाइसेमिया हो, जब रगतमा चिनी धेरै कम हुन्छ।

question: Which of the following is the best source of vitamin C?
options: Citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons
explanation: Citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons are rich sources of vitamin C, which prevents scurvy.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: भिटामिन सी को सबैभन्दा राम्रो स्रोत कुन हो?
options_ne: सुन्तला र कागती जस्ता अमिलो फल
explanation_ne: सुन्तला र कागती जस्ता अमिलो फल भिटामिन सी का राम्रा स्रोत हुन्, जसले स्कर्भी रोक्छ।

question: Iron deficiency anaemia is best prevented by eating which foods?
options: Green leafy vegetables, meat and lentils with vitamin C
explanation: Iron-rich foods such as green leafy vegetables, meat and lentils, eaten with vitamin C, help prevent iron deficiency anaemia.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: आइरनको कमीले हुने एनिमिया रोक्न कुन खाना खानु उत्तम हुन्छ?
options_ne: हरियो सागपात, मासु र दाल भिटामिन सी सँग
explanation_ne: हरियो सागपात, मासु र दाल जस्ता आइरनयुक्त खाना भिटामिन सी सँग खाँदा आइरनको कमीले हुने एनिमिया रोक्न मद्दत गर्छ।

question: Which mineral is needed for the formation of haemoglobin in red blood cells?
explanation: Iron is needed to form haemoglobin in red blood cells; iron deficiency causes anaemia.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: रातो रक्त कोषमा हेमोग्लोबिन बन्न कुन खनिज चाहिन्छ?
explanation_ne: रातो रक्त कोषमा हेमोग्लोबिन बन्न आइरन चाहिन्छ; आइरनको कमीले एनिमिया हुन्छ।

question: Protein is mainly needed by the body for what?
options: Growth, repair and building body tissues
explanation: Protein is needed for growth, repair and maintenance of body tissues, and for making enzymes and antibodies.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: प्रोटिन शरीरलाई मुख्य रूपमा केका लागि चाहिन्छ?
options_ne: वृद्धि, मर्मत र शरीरका तन्तु बनाउन
explanation_ne: प्रोटिन वृद्धि, मर्मत र शरीरका तन्तुको मर्मतसम्भारका लागि चाहिन्छ र इन्जाइम तथा एन्टिबडी बनाउन पनि।

question: After birth, how long does it normally take for the uterus to return to its pre-pregnant size?
explanation: The uterus normally returns to its pre-pregnant size (involution) over about six weeks after birth.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Maternal and Child Health Nursing
question_ne: जन्मपछि पाठेघर गर्भावस्थाअघिको आकारमा फर्कन सामान्यतया कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation_ne: जन्मपछि पाठेघर सामान्यतया करिब छ हप्तामा गर्भावस्थाअघिको आकारमा फर्कन्छ।

question: A newborn who is not feeding well, is unusually sleepy and has a low temperature should be suspected of having what?
options: A serious infection such as sepsis
explanation: Poor feeding, lethargy and temperature instability in a newborn suggest a serious infection such as sepsis and need urgent referral.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Maternal and Child Health Nursing
question_ne: दूध राम्रोसँग नखाने, असामान्य रूपमा सुस्त र कम तापक्रम भएको नवजातमा के शंका गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: नवजातमा दूध राम्रोसँग नखानु, सुस्त हुनु र तापक्रम अस्थिर हुनुले सेप्सिस जस्तो गम्भीर संक्रमण संकेत गर्छ र तत्काल रेफर चाहिन्छ।

question: Semi-solid foods should be introduced to a baby at what age, in addition to breast milk?
explanation: Semi-solid complementary foods are introduced at six months of age, while breastfeeding continues.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Maternal and Child Health Nursing
question_ne: स्तन दूधसँगै बच्चालाई अर्ध-ठोस खाना कुन उमेरमा दिन थाल्नुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: अर्ध-ठोस पूरक खाना छ महिनाको उमेरमा दिन थालिन्छ, स्तनपान जारी राख्दै।

question: A balanced diet is best described as what?
options: Eating foods from all food groups in the right amounts
explanation: A balanced diet includes foods from all food groups, carbohydrates, protein, fats, vitamins and minerals, in the right proportions.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: सन्तुलित आहार भनेको के हो?
options_ne: सबै खाद्य समूहका खाना सही मात्रामा खानु
explanation_ne: सन्तुलित आहारमा कार्बोहाइड्रेट, प्रोटिन, बोसो, भिटामिन र खनिजसहित सबै खाद्य समूहका खाना सही अनुपातमा हुन्छन्।

question: Which of the following is a drug that lowers blood pressure?
explanation: Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker used to lower blood pressure.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये कुन औषधिले रक्तचाप घटाउँछ?
explanation_ne: एम्लोडिपिन रक्तचाप घटाउन प्रयोग हुने क्याल्सियम च्यानल ब्लकर हो।

question: Which of the following is a contraindication for giving aspirin to a child with a viral fever?
explanation: Aspirin in children with viral illness can cause Reye's syndrome, a rare but serious liver and brain disorder, so it should be avoided.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: भाइरल ज्वरो भएको बच्चालाई एस्पिरिन दिनु निषेध हुनुको कारण के हो?
explanation_ne: भाइरल रोग भएका बच्चामा एस्पिरिनले रेय सिन्ड्रोम गराउन सक्छ, जुन दुर्लभ तर गम्भीर कलेजो र मस्तिष्कको विकार हो, त्यसैले बेवास्ता गर्नुपर्छ।

question: Oral rehydration solution (ORS) contains mainly what?
explanation: ORS contains water, sodium, potassium, chloride and glucose, which together replace the fluids and salts lost in diarrhoea.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: जीवनजल (ORS) मा मुख्य रूपमा के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ORS मा पानी, सोडियम, पोटासियम, क्लोराइड र ग्लुकोज हुन्छ, जसले झाडामा गुमेको तरल पदार्थ र नुन पुनः दिन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a good source of iodine in the diet?
explanation: Iodised salt is the main dietary source of iodine, which prevents goitre and supports normal thyroid function.
source: PSC Staff Nurse syllabus — Pharmacology and Nutrition
question_ne: आहारमा आयोडिनको राम्रो स्रोत कुन हो?
explanation_ne: आयोडिनयुक्त नुन आयोडिनको मुख्य आहार स्रोत हो, जसले गलगाँड रोक्छ र थाइराइडको सामान्य कार्यमा सहयोग गर्छ।
